comparison.objective: Drop a glove box safely, remove its old filter, and insert a replacement.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneously squeeze two sprung walls, articulate the box, extract a tabbed filter, and align and insert a new filter.
comparison.success_condition: No stop is forced; old filter is out, new filter is seated within tight pose tolerances, and everything is released and still.
comparison.reason: This tests simultaneous compliant release and component replacement, not adjustment retention and energy-dissipation commissioning.
